name: Hokenshitsu no Yasashii Jugyou
source:
Katsura doesn't have a girlfriend. But there are two girls whom he can talk naturally at school, Touko, a sick-room teacher, and Satsuki, a Japanese teacher. But he never thought that he would have an erotic relationship with them....

[From ErogeShop]
